Careers Information for Parents/Carers
How Parents Can Support Their Child’s Career Aspirations
Start the Conversation. Talking about careers at home makes a big difference. Ask your child what they enjoy, what they are curious about, and what they might want to do after school. Help them explore different career pathways and keep the conversation open and positive.
Explore Skills and Strengths Together
Help your child think about:
This helps them understand which careers might fit their strengths. You can also encourage them to talk to friends and family about their jobs to learn about different workplaces.

What they enjoy
How they work best
What kind of environment suits them
Connect School Activities to Future Careers
Careers learning happens throughout school. Talk to your child about:
Employer talks
Work experience
Use Unifrog Together
Unifrog is a powerful tool for exploring careers and planning next steps.
Over 1300 job profiles

Apprenticeship Information
You may find Amazing Apprenticeships helpful for understanding routes, employers and opportunities. Apprenticeship guides are invaluable if you’d like a parent‑friendly overview.

Work experience is one of the most valuable ways for students to understand the world of work.

pageCache.text:
Careers
HGSS Careers Mission Statement
We want to challenge students to be the best version of themselves. To aspire and aim high for their career goals, whilst encouraging them to work hard to build a strong network from which to gain the experience they need to navigate towards their chosen path. Challenge, Aspire, Navigate.
Challenge. Aspire. Navigate.
We believe that preparation for the world of work is not an add‑on — it is a fundamental part of education. Whether students plan to progress to further study, higher education, apprenticeships or employment, our aim is to ensure they have the knowledge, skills and guidance to make informed, ambitious choices.
Our Commitment to Students and Families
We are committed to providing high-quality careers guidance for all students. Our careers programme is aligned with the Gatsby Benchmarks, ensuring students receive effective and up-to-date careers education. A dedicated Careers Adviser provides impartial advice and guidance, helping students explore future pathways, training opportunities and career options. Students and parents/carers can also access Unifrog, which provides valuable careers information, Labour Market Information (LMI), and guidance on a wide range of education, training and employment routes.
Students' experience:
We know that employers increasingly value skills, experience and character alongside qualifications. Our programme helps students develop these attributes early and apply them confidently in future applications.
Sixth Form: Preparing for Life Beyond School
Our Sixth Form careers enrichment programme prepares students for the next stage of their journey—whether that is university, apprenticeships or entering the workplace. Students benefit from:
This ensures every student leaves HGSS with confidence, clarity and a strong sense of direction.
UCAS workshops
Apprenticeship guidance
Sessions on independent living and adult life
